name: Saiminjutsu 2
source:
In Saiminjutsu 2, down on his luck protagonist Susumu Sakurai, facing bullying at school, problems at home and severe dislike from his childhood friend, gains a boon when a mysterious stranger, Shinta Murakoshi, moves into his apartment. Seeing our young protagonist's plight, he offers to teach Susumu the mysterious power of hypnotism...

[Slightly edited from a [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250108235158/http://www.menhelmate.org/2010/01/saiminjutsu-2.html]review[/url] by Asceai]
translation:
在《齐民术2》中，运气不佳的主角樱井进面临着学校的欺凌、家庭的问题以及儿时好友的强烈厌恶，但当一位神秘的陌生人村越新太搬进他的公寓时，他却得到了恩惠。看到年轻主人公的困境，他主动提出要教苏苏姆催眠术的神秘力量……

[根据Asceai的 [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250108235158/http://www.menhelmate.org/2010/01/saiminjutsu-2.html] 评论[/url] 稍作编辑]
